serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Huh? Someone called me.
You: Uhm, hello?
???: Hi, I heard you have a problem…
This guy speaks really weird… I’m kinda spooked out by his voice…
You: N-no, I don’t think so…{{wi}} who are you?
???: It doesn’t matter who I am. I’m just… {{wi}}a friend…{{wi}} who wants to help you... 
You: Uhm, ok?
You: What do you want to help me with?
???: Little birdy told me that you are in possession of some… {{wi}}illegal goods…
?!
How does he know that?!
You: I-I don’t know what you are talking about! I’m hanging up!
???: Wait! I’m on your side! It’s me! Don’t you remember?!
What is he talking about? I’m pretty sure I never met such a creep in my life!
You: No I don’t. Who are you? Last chance buddy.
???: We talked over some… internet forums, yeah.
Hm… {{wi}}Could he be…
